title: Make the bug reproducible
hook: “It broke” lacks the input that produced the failure.

knows: reading short labels and comparing simple counts
doesNotKnow: Specify input, expected output and actual output in a bug report.

objective: Specify input, expected output and actual output in a bug report.

claims.text: Scenario, hook and prediction: “It broke” lacks the input that produced the failure. Which report supports a reproduction attempt? Correct option: Input expected actual. All fixture labels, example words, dates, task durations and file fields are stipulated exercise data.
claims.source: Explicit exercise fixture in src/lib/lifehacks/studyCatalog.ts and pure rules in studyModels.ts. All times, sizes, deadlines and outcomes describe this exercise only; no empirical productivity or learning effect is inferred. claims.text: The three fields allow a reproduction attempt against the same input. Reproducing a symptom is evidence about that case, not proof of its root cause.
